how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-darkshore-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:4762:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ north of Auberdine to the first waterfall along the Cliffspring River and draw a sample from the pool there.
rows.quest:4762:obj:1: Return to ⟦E2⟧ in Auberdine with the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:4762:details:0: ⟦E4⟧ has begun turning foul and corrupted. It empties into the ⟦E5⟧'s Edge, and I ⟦E6⟧ the wash will affect Auberdine soon. I suspect the Blackwood furbolgs up-river are the cause of the taint, but I also suspect that they aren't the true ⟦E7⟧ of it.
rows.quest:4762:details:1: Take this sampling tube and go to the mouth of the river to our north. Proceed inland to the first waterfall and draw a sample from the pool there. You'll see a bridge overhead. Once you have a sample, return to me in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4762:progress:0: The pollution of the Cliffspring River is but the start of an alarming trend here in ⟦E8⟧.  The sample you provide will help us formalize a plan... a plan of attack, I am starting to suspect.
rows.quest:4762:completion:0: It's no surprise how tainted this water is, but just look at how putrid it is becoming! It would seem that action is needed sooner than later, eh ⟦1⟧?
rows.quest:4762:completion:1: To our east is ⟦E9⟧; it is the real source of this corruption, one that I have seen in times past. I predict this sample will confirm this. We might be able to enact a cure for it here, but in order to even try we will need assistance. When that time comes ⟦2⟧, I hope you will be able to give the aid we need.
rows.quest:5713:obj:0: Protect Sentinel Aynasha, then speak with Onaeya at Maestra's Post in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:5713:details:0: I was traveling to Auberdine with an important message when I was attacked by the furbolg Marosh and his trackers. During the attack I was poisoned, leaving me barely able to stand. I can make an antidote, but it will take time before it is ready.
rows.quest:5713:details:1: I would ask that you defend me until I can apply the antidote. I will aid you with my bow as best I can.
rows.quest:5713:details:2: Should we survive, I will be able deliver my message to Auberdine, while you speak with Onaeya at Maestra's Post to inform her of this incident.
rows.quest:5713:progress:0: Have you seen of Sentinel Aynasha on the road? She left on an important mission but she has not yet returned.
rows.quest:5713:completion:0: You bring most welcome news ⟦3⟧. It is good to hear that Aynasha is alive and well thanks to you. I would hope that you might accept a reward for your valor. May ⟦E11⟧ watch over you and light your path.
rows.quest:963:obj:0: Free the spirit of Anaya Dawnrunner and bring her pendant back to Cerellean Whiteclaw in Auberdine.
rows.quest:963:details:0: In the aftermath of the battles at the ⟦E12⟧, I heard that Ameth'Aran had been destroyed, its people dead, including my love, Anaya.
rows.quest:963:details:1: I would never have thought, thousands of years later, that memories of Anaya would still haunt my dreams. Wandering the woods of ⟦E8⟧ in a stupor, I found myself in the ruins of Ameth'Aran... where I saw the haunted spirit of my beloved.
rows.quest:963:details:2: She must be freed, but I lack the heart to do it. Her spirit must be destroyed.
rows.quest:963:progress:0: With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into ⟦E13⟧, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
rows.quest:963:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦4⟧. Perhaps it would have been better... if I had done it myself. But even after these thousands of years, I could not bear to raise my hand against my beloved.
rows.quest:963:completion:1: Please, I would be alone with my grief...

Shorry for any deceptshion, but the nightelves do not apprecimerate my liquor trade in their townsh. I put shomething special in thish box to show my gratitude for yer effortsh. Enjoy!"
rows.quest:2138:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ the forest of 20 Rabid Thistle Bears and return to Tharnariun Treetender in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:2138:details:0: As I had feared, the cure does not work.
rows.quest:2138:details:1: It saddens me greatly to order the death of any of nature's beasts, but the sick and tainted thistle bears must be put down.
rows.quest:2138:details:2: Return to the forest and destroy 20 rabid thistle bears, ⟦9⟧. It will most certainly not put a stop to the plague but it will slow down the ⟦E17⟧ the animals are doing to our forest and its inhabitants for a short time.
rows.quest:2138:completion:0: You have done Auberdine a great service, ⟦10⟧, but your task is not yet complete.
rows.quest:4730:obj:0: Take the ⟦E18⟧ to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4730:details:0: The half-devoured corpse of what might have been a giant sea mammal lies on the beach. A band of murlocs, stronger than those found closer to Auberdine, have taken up residence around the fallen creature. Enough of the creature remains that a suitable sample of its bones could be delivered to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4730:progress:0: Hello again, ⟦11⟧!  Are you here to report on another discovery?
rows.quest:4730:completion:0: The bones you have are from gentle sea mammals that are known to inhabit the waters surrounding the base of ⟦E19⟧. They had never been known to violently beach themselves like the threshers had been known to. Why would these creatures do this, I wonder? Well, perhaps the study of their remains will bear the fruits of knowledge that we seek.
rows.quest:4730:completion:1: Again, thank you for your aid. Please accept this honorarium from the Temple of the Moon.

rows.quest:947:obj:0: Bring 5 Scaber Stalks and 1 ⟦E26⟧ to Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine.

rows.quest:947:completion:1: And when you were at ⟦E29⟧, did you find anything to confirm the warnings of the Ancients?

rows.quest:948:details:0: ⟦E22⟧, an Ancient of Lore at the ⟦E30⟧, knows of your journey to Cliffwater Falls and wishes to speak with you. The grove lies to the south, nestled near the mountains.
rows.quest:948:details:1: The Ancients are patient and wise, ⟦18⟧. But if ⟦E22⟧ seeks your counsel concerning what you saw in the falls, then I ⟦E6⟧ it is urgent.
rows.quest:948:completion:2: We have matters...to discuss. You and I.
rows.quest:949:obj:0: Find a clue in the Twilight's ⟦E23⟧ camp at the Master's ⟦E25⟧.
rows.quest:949:details:0: The Twilight's ⟦E23⟧'s purpose at the Master's ⟦E25⟧ is not known. But it must be dark.
rows.quest:949:details:1: Search through their camp at the ⟦E25⟧... Search for some thing that may teach us their intentions.
rows.quest:949:details:2: For we must learn their intentions before a plan is made.
rows.quest:949:completion:0: This book is hand printed in an ancient language, and illustrated by a master artist.
rows.quest:950:details:0: Peering into the Twilight Tome is maddening. Text begins to swim and dance after only a moment's glance, and once beautiful scrollwork twists into grotesque shapes.
rows.quest:950:details:1: Tearing away one page of insane scribbles is all that is possible before a swoon overtakes you.
rows.quest:950:completion:0: A chaotic, primal magic surrounds this parchment of scribbles. I sense the work of the old ones in it.
rows.quest:950:completion:1: Let us hope it reveals the purpose of the Twilight's ⟦E23⟧ in ⟦E8⟧...
rows.quest:982:obj:0: Recover the ⟦E33⟧ and the ⟦E34⟧ for Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine. Both items should be found aboard the wreckage of the ships to the north of the village.
rows.quest:982:details:0: Off the coast of ⟦E8⟧ to our north are two wrecked ships - the Silver Dawning and the ⟦E5⟧ Veil. Some time ago, both ships ran afoul of the blasted murlocs as they sailed across the vast sea into Auberdine. They now lie at the bottom of the ocean as trophies for those fiends.
rows.quest:982:details:1: Both captains didn't make it out that night, and their logs and other effects are still below in lockboxes. I'd like for you to recover them for us; it would mean a lot to the crew members still around these parts.
rows.quest:982:progress:0: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
rows.quest:982:completion:0: You've done us here in Auberdine a great service, lad. We'll make sure that their effects are properly taken care of.
rows.quest:982:completion:1: As for you, please have this. It is the least I can do for someone with the bravery to set things right.

rows.quest:97894:title: Business in Auberdine
rows.quest:945:obj:0: Help Therylune escape, then tell Therysil at the Shrine of Aessina that her sister is safe.

rows.quest:965:obj:0: Find Balthule ⟦E37⟧ near the Tower of Althalaxx in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:965:details:0: Hail, young ⟦26⟧. I am Elissa Starbreeze, and it is my charge to protect Auberdine from harm.
rows.quest:965:details:1: To this end, I sent Balthule ⟦E37⟧ to observe the strange happenings around the Tower of Althalaxx to the northeast.
rows.quest:965:details:2: It is past time that he should have returned. I worry that he has encountered some unforeseen danger in the forest. I would be most appreciative if you would find him and see that he is doing well.
rows.quest:965:completion:0: Elissa sent you? Then it is good tidings you bring. I have troubling news to report to her, and had no means with which to deliver it.
rows.quest:966:obj:0: Collect 4 Worn Parchments for Balthule ⟦E37⟧ near the Tower of Althalaxx.
rows.quest:966:details:0: A group of warlocks has taken up residence around and inside the tower. I would have returned to Auberdine to report to Elissa earlier, but I was afraid that I might ⟦E38⟧ something while I was away.
rows.quest:966:details:1: Delgren suspected such a company might be gathering at the tower, but did not know why.
rows.quest:966:details:2: BA few scraps of parchment that the warlocks carry have found their way to my hands, but I need more to complete the puzzle. I warn you not to venture into the tower, however, the warlocks there are much more powerful!
rows.quest:966:progress:0: Have you found any more of their scrolls? I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.
rows.quest:966:completion:0: Many thanks, ⟦27⟧. This should shed some light on this warlocks' gathering...
rows.quest:966:completion:1: Hmm... the Cult of the Dark Strand... I have never heard of this group before. Having no knowledge of their history, it is all but impossible to say what their plans must be.
rows.quest:966:completion:2: There is no more time to delay. Warning must be delivered to Delgren immediately.
rows.quest:967:obj:0: Deliver Balthule's letter to Delgren the Purifier in ⟦E10⟧ Forest.
rows.quest:967:details:0: My master, Delgren the Purifier, is a paladin who has graciously offered his assistance in defending our forests from the forces of the demons and ⟦E39⟧. He has taught me much about the ⟦E40⟧ and the art of ⟦E41⟧.
rows.quest:967:details:1: Delgren must know of the cult's operations immediately.
rows.quest:967:details:2: You will find him far south of here at Maestra's Post in ⟦E10⟧ Forest. Be swift, I ⟦E6⟧ the Dark Strand's ⟦E42⟧ grows with each passing hour.
rows.quest:967:progress:0: You have some business with me, ⟦28⟧?

rows.quest:967:completion:1: This is disturbing news. When ⟦E39⟧ or demonic forces are found, I help the Sentinels destroy them.

rows.quest:2139:obj:0: Find and kill the Den Mother.
rows.quest:2139:details:0: The survival of our people and lands comes at unfortunate costs, ⟦29⟧.
rows.quest:2139:details:1: You have spilled the blood of nature's servants; many sick animals you have felled. The people of Auberdine are indebted to you, for the forest's pain is eased - even if only for a moment.
rows.quest:2139:details:2: I have one final task for you, but be warned, you will have to kill again. It is my hope that this will be the last time I call upon you, ⟦30⟧.
rows.quest:2139:details:3: In a cave to the northeast, near ⟦E43⟧, resides the Den Mother. Slay her.
rows.quest:2139:progress:0: With the infected Den Mother slain, the population of Rabid Thistle Bears entering our land is lessened. Waste no time, ⟦31⟧.
rows.quest:2139:completion:0: You have fought for Auberdine with bravery and honor, ⟦32⟧. In our war torn lands, death and despair are common. Many will not rise to meet the challenge of life in our new home, choosing instead to hide in their homes or escape to the more fortified lands of the ⟦E44⟧.
rows.quest:2139:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦33⟧. Perhaps someday soon we shall fight along side as comrades versus another foe.
rows.quest:4740:obj:0: Find and slay the murloc known as Murkdeep. The creature is thought to be defending the murloc huts south of Auberdine along the water.
rows.quest:4740:obj:1: Report the death of Murkdeep to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

rows.quest:4740:details:2: Murkdeep was last spotted at a hutted murloc camp south of Auberdine, and is thought to be protecting the huts there. Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4740:progress:0: Greetings ⟦34⟧ - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Murkdeep?
rows.quest:4740:completion:0: Well, looks like you're here to more than just inquire! The citizens will be delighted to know that tonight they will sleep a little bit more soundly and safer.
rows.quest:4740:completion:1: You've acted as the executioner of justice for the people of Auberdine today, ⟦35⟧. For that, I would like to offer you this as a suitable reward... for a true hero of the Auberdine people.
rows.quest:4763:obj:0: Fill the ⟦E45⟧ at the Auberdine Moonwell.
rows.quest:4763:obj:1: Gather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps.
rows.quest:4763:obj:2: Mix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor.
rows.quest:4763:obj:3: Take the ⟦E46⟧ and bring it to ⟦E2⟧ in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4763:details:0: We've learned that a source of furbolg corruption is from the satyr. They hold sway via talismans that they channel magic through. If the furbolg have a ⟦E47⟧ at ⟦E48⟧, we must lure out the satyr corruptor and take that talisman!
rows.quest:4763:details:1: Fill this bowl at our moonwell and take samples of the furbolgs' food from their northern camp. Mix them and place it near the bonfire by the river; any furbolgs who eat will be cleansed just long enough to lure out the satyr corruptor... who then you must slay!
rows.quest:4763:progress:0: The ⟦E46⟧ is a sinister device that only serves to pervert the balance of nature. When you obtain this item from whatever satyr is tormenting the furbolgs and bring it to me for disposal, we will have won a great victory this day!
rows.quest:4763:completion:0: We have just begun this war to reclaim our forest from the forces of corruption, but a ⟦E41⟧ this day has been won! ⟦36⟧, the people of Auberdine owe you a debt of gratitude that will never be easily repaid. Please accept this along with our thanks. What we have learned here today may one day free our furbolg friends from the shackles of torment permanently.
rows.quest:4731:obj:0: Take the ⟦E49⟧ to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4731:details:0: Another set of sea turtle remains lie beached on the coastline. This set of remains has an abandoned carriage half buckled to the turtle's shell. Perhaps this creature was driven to the shoreline by unknown beings rather than beaching itself as some of the other remains suggested. Powerful Greymist murlocs have made the carcass of this creature their current home.
rows.quest:4731:details:1: In the carriage, you find a box with strange markings on it; perhaps Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine can make sense of it.
rows.quest:4731:progress:0: Hello again, ⟦37⟧.  The work you have done on behalf of the Temple of the Moon has been outstanding.  Are we to be blessed with more of your effort on our behalf?
rows.quest:4731:completion:0: I have heard of the kinds of carriages found on the back of that turtle. Those I do believe are naga carriages, used both in ⟦E41⟧ and in transportation of their supplies on to land. The markings on the box you found are of the naga; perhaps the creature you discovered was killed as it was heading further south... to ⟦E10⟧ maybe?
rows.quest:4731:completion:1: I will be sure to send this box to ⟦E50⟧ with the rest of your discoveries. This is for you - thank you again for your assistance.
rows.quest:4732:obj:0: Take the ⟦E51⟧ to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4732:details:0: You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of ⟦E8⟧ some time ago. It has been picked nearly clean by Greymist murlocs, the very ones who now have encamped themselves around the creature's remains. Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.
rows.quest:4732:progress:0: Greetings once again ⟦38⟧ - do you have any more discoveries to report to the Temple of the Moon?
rows.quest:4732:completion:0: You've found even more beached creatures, ⟦39⟧? Sea turtles were commonly found frolicking along the base of Nordrassil before it was destroyed. With the birth of ⟦E19⟧, however, these creatures have been seen in ever decreasing numbers. Some, as we have discovered, end their lives here for some unknown reason.
rows.quest:4732:completion:1: Your aid will perhaps unlock the mystery before us. Please accept this in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
rows.quest:4733:obj:0: Take the ⟦E18⟧ to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4733:details:0: The remains of what appear to be a giant thresher have washed ashore on the rocky inlet of the Twilight ⟦E52⟧. The thresher is several times larger than any of the other threshers spotted in these parts. Wherever it came from, this creature would not seem to have been native to ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:4733:details:1: Though the creature has been picked apart in places, enough of it remains to gather a suitable sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4733:progress:0: Thanks be to ⟦E11⟧ - I am glad to see you again, dear ⟦40⟧.  ⟦E53⟧'s work on the strange beaching phenomena continues here in ⟦E8⟧.  Might you have anything additional to offer us?

rows.quest:729:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ south and check on Prospector Remtravel.
rows.quest:729:details:0: What an honor it was when Master Greywhisker assigned me to work under the guidance of the great Prospector Remtravel. At the academy in ⟦E36⟧ everyone knew of Remtravel's great discoveries.
rows.quest:729:details:1: But the prospector is rather... um... oblivious ...to his surroundings.
rows.quest:729:details:2: We had uncovered evidence of a great society. Horrible golems sprang forth from the ground and overran the site. Remtravel never seemed to notice. I ran back to Auberdine for help.
rows.quest:729:details:3: Please travel south and see if the prospector is okay!
rows.quest:729:completion:0: Hollee. is that you? I need some help chiseling this stone. Hand me my stone brush, I think I see something.
rows.quest:729:completion:1: Hey, you're not Hollee! Don't suppose you've seen my stone brush?
rows.quest:729:completion:2: Never mind that now! I promised the League I'd send the mysterious fossil I found. Where did Hollee go?
rows.quest:729:completion:3: So much work to be done! Now where is that mysterious fossil... and my brush... and Hollee...
rows.quest:729:completion:4: And who are you... 'tis no matter, so long as you're here to help.
rows.quest:729:completion:5: Let me know when you're ready to start looking.
rows.quest:731:obj:0: Protect Prospector Remtravel as he searches for the mysterious fossil, then return to Archaeologist Hollee in Auberdine.
rows.quest:731:details:0: So then, Hollee... oh that's right, you are not Hollee. Where's Hollee?
rows.quest:731:details:1: Bah, that's beside the point. We must find that stone brush... I mean the mysterious fossil! We must find that fossil. The Explorers' League in ⟦E50⟧ will want some indication as to what I've been doing.
rows.quest:731:details:2: Let me know when you are ready and we will hunt down that brush.... I mean fossil! We shall find something in writing to satisfy the League.
rows.quest:731:completion:0: Thank the stars Prospector Remtravel is safe! I told you he was absent minded. I can't believe he insisted on staying there with all of those horrible creatures lurking about.
